item.title: You Can Now Play Minecraft on YouTube
item.description:
A version of Mojang's legendary survival crafting sandbox game Minecraft is now playable directly on YouTube. Thanks to a pair of creative YouTubers, Minecraft has been condensed down to a playable version that runs directly on the platform. This version of Minecraft can be accessed on both the YouTube mobile app and the desktop browser version of the website.

Since its full release in 2011, Minecraft has become a global sensation, with over 400 million copies sold, giving it the title of the best-selling video game of all time. While Minecraft was originally released exclusively on PC, it has been ported to essentially every platform it could have been in the past 15 years. However, being playable directly on YouTube is certainly a first for Minecraft , and it seems fitting given the game's history with the platform.

You Can Now Play Five Nights at Freddy's on YouTube

A talented YouTuber has created a version of the iconic horror game Five Nights at Freddy's that can be played as a video directly on the platform.

By Drew Swanson

Minecraft Has a Playable Version on YouTube

YouTubers Atlas Arcade and Animated Subtitles have teamed up to produce a video that runs a version of Minecraft from within the video itself. In this version of Minecraft , players are tasked with defeating the Ender Dragon, first by destroying two End Crystals with snowballs before taking out their bow and shooting the Ender Dragon with arrows to fell the beast. While the game doesn't include the typical crafting mechanics that Minecraft is famous for, it is still an impressive feat nonetheless.

This version of Minecraft was accomplished thanks to the power of YouTube's 360-degree video feature combined with animated subtitles for Minecraft 's bow and snowball HUD. PC users can use the A, W, S, and D keys to move around and target the Ender Dragon, while mobile users can touch the screen or tilt their device to aim. For a more difficult experience, Atlas Arcade recommends speeding up the playback of the video to make the Ender Dragon more difficult to hit.

Minecraft isn't the first iconic game that Atlas Arcade has translated into a playable video. YouTube playable versions of Doom , Five Nights at Freddy's , and even Mario Kart can also be found on the same channel. These may not be the complete versions of their respective games, but the fact that they can be played within a YouTube video takes some serious ingenuity, making them impressive feats regardless.

YouTube and Minecraft have been intrinsically linked basically since the game launched into beta in 2009. Minecraft really blew up on the platform, with some of the most famous gaming YouTubers of today getting their start with Minecraft Let's Plays. To honor this connection between YouTube and Minecraft , 2025's A Minecraft Movie featured cameos from famous Minecraft YouTubers like DanTDM, Aphmau, Mumbo Jumbo, LDShadowLady, and Valkyrae. Now, it feels like Minecraft has finally come full circle with a playable version on the platform that helped boost its popularity to become the cultural juggernaut it is today.

A Minecraft Movie: Squared stars Kirsten Dunst as Alex and will be the sequel to A Minecraft Movie , and it's set to release July 23, 2027.

item.title: New Star Wars Zero Company Edition Officially Revealed
item.description:
The Collector's Edition of Star Wars Zero Company was officially revealed during a panel featuring the game's cast and crew at San Diego Comic Con 2026. Produced by Limited Run Games, Star Wars fans can pre-order the Star Wars Zero Company Collector's Edition from now until August 23, ahead of the game's August 27 release date. This edition of the game will set fans back a hefty $299.99, and is available for the PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X/S versions of Star Wars Zero Company .

Star Wars Zero Company is an upcoming turn-based tactics game from Bit Reactor and EA, and it's clearly a game developed by former XCOM developers. The game is set during the Clone Wars and features a cast of misfit mercenaries, known as the Zero Company, tasked with carrying out covert operations for the Republic. In true XCOM fashion, Star Wars Zero Company features mechanics like turn-based squad battles, permadeath, and an upgradeable home base.

Star Wars Zero Company Could Give Turn-Based Tactics Its ARC Raiders Moment

Star Wars Zero Company has the potential to catapult the turn-based tactics genre into the mainstream, just as ARC Raiders did with it's niche genre.

By Christopher Adams

Star Wars Zero Company Collector's Edition from Limited Run Games Revealed, Costs $300

  • Pre-Order the Star Wars Zero Company Collector's Edition now from Limited Run Games

Revealed during a panel at SDCC, Limited Run Games and EA are giving fans some enticing goodies in the Star Wars Zero Company Collector's Edition, albeit at a steep price point. Included in the $300 collector's edition package are a variety of physical collectibles, including:

  • Star Wars Zero Company Game
    • All Console games will be shipped ahead of the Collector's Edition. PC Steam game codes and Deluxe Edition Upgrade codes will be delivered via email on the official release date.

  • Premium Foil Stamped Box
  • SteelBook
  • Retro Jewel Case
  • Variant Star Wars The Black Series Electronic Thermal Detonator
    • Includes: stand and instructions

  • 31" x 12" Desk Mat
  • Trick Pin
  • Logo Pin
  • Character Cards

  • Certificate of Authenticity

The most interesting part of this collector's edition, and likely the source of its high price tag, is a replica of a Thermal Detonator grenade from the Star Wars franchise. Collectors can long-press the top button to switch the detonator between standard and “droid popper” modes, and pressing or jiggling the detonator will trigger an explosion sound effect from the game. Whether this makes the package worth $300 is up to collectors to decide, but it's worth noting that the Collector's Edition content won't ship until April 1-June 30, 2027.

Beyond Star Wars Zero Company , Star Wars game fans have a lot to look forward to throughout the rest of 2026. A new Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order manga is set to release in December, and the embattled Star Wars KOTOR remake is rumored to be re-revealed later this year as well.

item.title: Amazon Gaming Boss Says $1,000+ Consoles May Be Good For Amazon Luna
item.description:
The head of Amazon Gaming claims that the rising price of home consoles could be a major boon for the company's Amazon Luna cloud gaming platform. Amazon first launched its cloud streaming platform in 2022 as an alternative to home consoles.

Cloud gaming has seen significant growth in recent years, buoyed by the rise of high-speed internet and online gaming. Many of the gaming industry's biggest companies offer their own forms of cloud gaming, allowing players to stream games without downloading them, like Xbox Cloud Gaming and Cloud Streaming with PS Plus Premium. Nintendo has also made heavy use of cloud streaming for games that may be too big for the Nintendo Switch, including Control and Hitman 3 , among others. Now, Amazon Luna may be getting an unexpected benefit from the recent RAM shortage that has plagued the gaming industry.

Prime Gaming Reveals 12 Free Games for July 2026

Amazon Prime Gaming reveals the list of currently available and upcoming free games throughout July 2026.

By Joshua Duckworth

Amazon Luna May Benefit from Higher Console Prices

In a recent interview with The Game Business, Amazon Gaming's General Manager Jeff Gattis spoke about Amazon Luna's position amidst the RAM crisis. Gattis referenced Valve's Steam Machine selling for more than $1,000 at launch, suggesting that many potential games would be in the "consideration pool for a cloud gaming solution." Gattis stressed that Luna was not originally marketed towards hardcore gamers, instead focusing on a demographic that "hasn't been well served by consoles and PC" with the rising cost of gaming. Amazon Luna supports a wide range of devices from PCs to mobile devices and was even recently added to Prime Video.

Jeff Gattis shared his thoughts on the future of Amazon Luna as well, with an optimistic outlook for the service. The Amazon Gaming boss shared the skepticism of many publishers about bringing their games to Luna, noting that many feel the streaming platform could "cannibalize their sales on other platforms." Gattis emphasized the idea that many fans using Luna would not have been able to access the games otherwise, continuing to push its Prime Video and Fire TV implementation. Amazon Luna has also continued to add big-name franchises to the platform, including the next Tomb Raider games.

Amazon Luna could look to benefit heavily from one of the biggest stories in the gaming industry in recent months. The ongoing RAM shortage has plagued the gaming industry since late 2025, exacerbated by the rising demand for RAM chips from AI data centers. Several RAM companies have adjusted their own practices and policies in response to the shortage, including Corsair making changes to its RAM kits to prevent scammers from selling fake products.

The RAM shortage has heavily impacted the price of gaming consoles, with many of the hottest platforms seeing significant spikes. Aside from the previously mentioned Steam Machine, Sony officially raised the price of the PlayStation 5 in April, increasing the price of the standard disc drive version of the console to $649.99 and even pushing the PS5 Pro to $899.99. The Xbox Series X and S also saw big price changes in late June, with the disc drive version of the Series X now selling for $799.99 for the 1 TB model. Gaming continues to become more expensive with the ongoing RAM crisis, and the trend shows no signs of slowing.

Gattis referenced Valve's Steam Machine selling for more than $1,000 at launch, suggesting that many potential games would be in the "consideration pool for a cloud gaming solution." Gattis stressed that Luna was not originally marketed towards hardcore gamers, instead focusing on a demographic that "hasn't been well served by consoles and PC" with the rising cost of gaming. Amazon Luna supports a wide range of devices from PCs to mobile devices and was even recently added to Prime Video.

Several RAM companies have adjusted their own practices and policies in response to the shortage, including Corsair making changes to its RAM kits to prevent scammers from selling fake products.

The RAM shortage has heavily impacted the price of gaming consoles, with many of the hottest platforms seeing significant spikes. Aside from the previously mentioned Steam Machine, Sony officially raised the price of the PlayStation 5 in April, increasing the price of the standard disc drive version of the console to $649.99 and even pushing the PS5 Pro to $899.99. The Xbox Series X and S also saw big price changes in late June, with the disc drive version of the Series X now selling for $799.99 for the 1 TB model. item.title: GTA Creator's Comments on Digital Games Become Timely After Viral PlayStation Account Loss
item.description:
A former GTA creator shares his stance on digital and physical media after Sony's recent decision to transition to digital-only games, at the same time as a PlayStation fan loses their account and is unable to play digital games. Currently, the Grand Theft Auto studio is one of the companies leading the charge in the push towards digital media.

Rockstar has built itself up as one of the juggernauts of the gaming industry, holding a wealth of iconic and recognizable titles under its belt. Grand Theft Auto serves as the company's biggest flagship franchise, with the launch of new games typically being some of the biggest releases in the gaming world. Rockstar has also seen major success in recent years with the Red Dead Redemption series, while also boasting several popular smaller properties such as Max Payne , Bully , and L.A. Noire among others. Now, one of the individuals who helped to found Rockstar Games has shared his thoughts on the benefits of digital games right when a post about the dangers of digital-only games became viral.

GTA 6 Fans Have Figured Out the Location of Jason's House

A group of keen-eyed GTA 6 fans believes it has pinpointed the location of Jason Duval's house, and the evidence is surprisingly convincing.

By Mohsen Baqery

Former GTA Creator Addresses Digital vs. Physical Games

Dan Houser shared his thoughts on the future of physical games during the recent San Diego Comic-Con. Houser said he "didn't personally care" whether physical games continue to be produced, though he added that companies should provide physical discs "if people want them." Houser did acknowledge the benefits of digital games for development studios, with developers able to continue to update games and fix problems following a game's release. Dan Houser previously worked as lead developer on both Grand Theft Auto 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 before leaving Rockstar Games in 2020.

Rockstar Games has been one of the companies at the forefront of the debate between physical and digital games in recent weeks. The company announced in June 2026 that the physical release of Grand Theft Auto 6 will not include a disc, instead containing a code for the game's digital version. The change was met with swift backlash from many members of the gaming community, who said that the digital-only release removes any possibility of resale and undermines the game's collectibility. The lack of a physical disc for Grand Theft Auto 6 could also draw concerns from fans about licensing for the game, with Sony fans already getting a first-hand look at the possible ramifications of a digital-only future.

Sony's Digital-Only Future Could Spell Trouble For Older Accounts

Sony sparked significant controversy when the company revealed that it will phase out physical game discs after 2027, meaning it will no longer produce discs for new PlayStation games starting in 2028. Fans have also discovered a major change in Sony's policy for inactive accounts, with accounts potentially being closed after three years of inactivity. The change has led to outrage among many fans, with some already claiming to have lost access to games on older PSN accounts. Such is the case of Twitter user RY3NO, who stated in a viral post that their brother's PSN account had been deleted after being inactive, and they couldn't play games downloaded on their PS3 because the license had expired.

The shift away from physical media has been far from exclusive to Rockstar or Sony's pre-existing consoles. Sony's change is expected to be connected to a similar change in the in-development PlayStation 6, with Sony's next home console rumored to be switching to a digital-only model. Xbox's upcoming Project Helix has also been the subject of heavy rumors about a potential shift to a digital-only model, with the console reportedly not even coming with a disc drive. The shift away from physical discs will likely continue to be a hot topic of discussion among gamers for years to come.

Source: GamesRadar
